subject: Encord Partnership - Video Annotation
text:
Hi Bryan,

Good to meet you on Monday. Glad we got the chance to dig into your use
case in a bit more detail. Essentially what you require is (1) an
easy-to-use video annotation platform to efficiently label key
objects/moments of interest from your data captured from DroneDeploy & (2)
effective workflow management & collaboration for Engrain
interns/stakeholders as you kickstart this project in July.

We're very much viewing this as a partnership -- your use case is our bread
and butter. Nick & I have supported dozens of early-stage startups like
Engrain over the past 6-12 get their video data labelled & data pipelines
setup/optimised. Looking forward to partnering closely & advising you on
best practice.

I've put together a commercial proposal (see attached) that includes our
standard Starter Tier terms. Once you've had a chance to sync internally, I
suggest we jump on a quick call before you head off on PTO to discuss
commercials & any action items required while you're off. I've put a holder
in for Thursday 19th 12pm ET - let me know if this doesn't work & we can
move about accordingly.

Thanks,
Jamie

-- 
Jamie Shelton

832 Sansome St.
San Francisco, CA 94111, United States of America
